newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bank of Thailand 1996 GDP seen near 7.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Thailand 1996 GDP seen near 7.0 pct.

text.p: Thailand's 1996 gross domestic product (GDP) should be close to 7.0 percent, and the current account deficit is expected to be near the 1995 level of 8.1 percent of GDP, a central bank spokeswoman said on Thursday.

"Despite the low export growth, the GDP for all of 1996 will not be lower than six percent but not higher than seven percent. I expect it to be close to 7.0 percent," spokeswoman Kleo-thong Hetrakul told reporters.
"I expect the current account deficit to stand near the 1995 level of 8.1 percent of GDP," she said.
The Bank of Thailand said exports in the first nine months of the year rose only 0.9 percent year-on-year, compared with a more than 20 percent rise in the same period last year.
In July, the central bank projected GDP would grow by 7.8 percent in 1996 and said the current account deficit was expected to total 7.8 percent of GDP.
